values.note: Permit and reservation required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; vacate at least 48 hours before returning. $10 a night PA residents, $15 non-residents.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/pinchot/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('Most campsites in Pennsylvania state forests can be reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site on Fireline Road (Thornhurst Tract): gravel parallel parking, max vehicle length 26 ft, ADA-accessible.

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers (state forest rule), single gravel parallel site taking 26 ft, reservation required. Not stated: a season for this site (the forest's booking page shows 'Open through Nov 11 2026'). Fees left as recorded (DCNR state forest rate).
